content.text: Confirmed: no insurance clause exists, while Garman installs software on site and converts Sparkling's data. I'll insert a covenant into General Matters.

input.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new Section 20(j) in General Matters
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as none appears in the Agreement, because Garman installs the Software at our Authorized Locations and converts our data. Our position is CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, E&O of USD 2,000,000 and cyber liability of USD 5,000,000 where our data is processed; we can consider E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 if coverage limits are an issue.

ops.text: (j) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Garman processes Sparkling's data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Garman shall also maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law and shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.
